episodes.synopsis: They say if you shoot for the moon, you’ll land among the stars. But with a lofty new goal before them, the members of TiNgS fear they may come crashing down to earth…
episodes.title: Haru Nabutame Does Not Shine

episodes.synopsis: A year has passed, and TiNgS is still slinging tickets on the street. They’ll need to work hard to sell out their venue, but their usual methods may not be up to the task…
episodes.title: Haru Nabatame Is “Shaky”

episodes.synopsis: Just a bad dream, or an omen of things to come? Kyoka isn’t sure, but nightmares become reality when her new manager introduces a shocking shakeup to TiNgS’ lineup.
episodes.title: Kyoka Tamaki the “Foil”

episodes.synopsis: Kyoka knows she can’t be an idol when she’s no one special; failure after failure proved that! But sometimes, a person is their own worst enemy.
episodes.title: Kyoka Tamaki Does Not Stand Out

episodes.synopsis: When opportunities come knocking, TiNgS will answer the door! But Rio’s big opportunity may leave a bitter aftertaste…
episodes.title: “Headstrong” Rio Seibu

episodes.synopsis: Rio absolutely REFUSES to be the center during the premiere of a new TiNgS song, and no one knows why. Something is holding her back, but she’s not eager to share feelings.
episodes.title: Rio Seibu Wants to Be Praised

episodes.synopsis: The capitalization of TiNgS’ name tells a story of division. Their manager wants to write a new chapter of that story — and this time, their name will tell a tale of unity.
episodes.title: Momiji Ito Will Not Go Back

episodes.synopsis: Can a star shine so brightly it drowns out the light of other stars? Do other stars notice they aren’t the brightest in the sky? Yukine knows the answer intimately.
episodes.title: Yukine Gionji Will Not Allow It

episodes.synopsis: If they want Haru to shine to her full potential, TINGS will need to bring their A-game when performing one of the first songs their full unit ever learned.
episodes.title: Haru Nabatame Does Not Trust

episodes.synopsis: TINGS has their hands full with one seemingly insurmountable hurdle, but another, even higher obstacle is waiting in the wings to rain on their parade…
episodes.title: Ren Kurogane Wants to Go Back

episodes.synopsis: Ren is determined to bring Haru back, but why is she so intent on dragging Haru away from TINGS? It seems a promise from the past brings pain to the present.
episodes.title: Kyoka Tamaki Is Not Discouraged

episodes.synopsis: The moment of truth is upon them, and now TINGS must shine in the way only they can. Anxious, inexperienced, utterly joyful — it’s time to show the real TINGS to the world.
episodes.title: TINGS Does Not Shine
